sections.heading: Gift Box with Window FAQ
sections.text: Questions Gift Box with Window FAQ What is the window made of? A clear PET film set into the lid, so the product is visible while the box stays rigid. Can the window be a custom shape? Yes. Rectangle, square, round, arch or a custom outline; the shape is checked on the sample before bulk production. Is a window box suitable for food? The box is used as outer gift packaging; food is normally wrapped or placed in cups or a tray inside. Tell us the product and we suggest the insert. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Magnetic or lift-off lid? Both work with a window. A lift-off lid gives the largest window area; a magnetic flap keeps a book-style opening.

A window box lets the product sell itself: a clear PET window in the lid shows clothing, sweets, soap or a gift set without opening the box. Children's and apparel brands, bakeries, soap and candle makers and gift shops order rigid window boxes for retail shelves and gift sets where the customer wants to see what is inside.
